text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I heard a teen magazine is coming to the academy for an interview soon.

text_block_list.name: Friend Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You know how they sometimes publish articles
introducing the girls at Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Friend Umamusume
text_block_list.text: A while ago, there was this huge photo of me sprinting around a corner in the paper, and I was pretty happy about it.
